verdict.rationale: Daily's docs state it can stream a session to any RTMP endpoint with configurable layouts and overlays. That is first-party live egress, which lets a large audience watch outside the session; the story's 'RTMP or HLS' is satisfied by RTMP alone. Missing for 10: no HLS output documented, only a one-line claim without in-depth docs (limits, start/stop API), no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, a live session can be egressed to RTMP or HLS so a large audience watches without joining the session

citations.quote: Stream to any RTMP endpoint with configurable layouts and overlays.
